next_action: Park front disc pad/caliper/rotor shopping unless a safety or fit dependency forces it back into scope.
release_gate: Rear axle brake work can proceed with rear-only capture, sample matching, and service checks; final road test still validates the complete brake system.
do_not_do: Do not let front disc catalog searches delay rear axle hard lines, rear hose, drums, wheel cylinders, or parking-brake work.

next_action: Buy a brake-rated 3/16 flare tube-nut set anyway, then photo tube label/printing, measure OD, count any Altivox kit fittings, sample-match thread/seat, and make practice double/inverted flares.
release_gate: Brake-rated 4.75 mm / 3/16 in tube, brake-rated steel flare tube nuts that match old Toyota thread/seat, old route copied, and at least five clean practice double/inverted flares.
do_not_do: Do not use bare/plumbing copper, compression fittings, guessed threads, first-attempt flares on final vehicle lines, or rear wheel cylinders as evidence that flare fittings are covered.

next_action: Remove/label only when hydraulics can be drained and capped; photograph both hose ends, bracket groove, retaining clip, free length, and axle droop route.
release_gate: Complete crimped brake hose assembly rated DOT/SAE J1401 or OEM-equivalent, matched to old sample/thread/seat/free length.
do_not_do: Do not buy generic roll hose, reused hose, or any hose with unmatched fittings or no brake rating.

next_action: User reports the received rear wheel cylinders seem to match exactly. Photograph/count every cylinder, keep packaging, then confirm side/position, bore, port thread/seat, pushrod, mounting, boot, and bleed-screw access against the opened drums before installation.
release_gate: Actual fitted count, bore, mounting bolt spacing, port thread/seat, pushrod end, boot shape, bleed screw size/access, and LH/RH or upper/lower position match old samples; no leaks after bleed.
do_not_do: Do not assume one visible top cylinder covers the full rear axle; do not fit a generic cylinder if bore, port, mount, or side/position differs.

next_action: User reports new rear brake shoes are on hand. Compare shoe width, arc, lining, web holes, and adjuster/parking-brake lever contact points to the opened drums before installation.
release_gate: New shoes match actual drum diameter/backing-plate family and both sides can adjust, apply, and return evenly after bedding.
do_not_do: Do not assume the shoe order includes springs, clips, adjusters, or wheel-cylinder fasteners.

item: Rear drum spring hold-down adjuster hardware
next_action: Compare Centric 116971-05110530 kit against opened drum layout before installation; replace all shoe return/hold-down/adjuster springs covered by the kit, and route external handbrake cable springs through the BR-REAR-009 hardware row if not included.
release_gate: Spring hooks, wire diameter, hold-down pin length, cups, adjusters, retaining clips, parking-brake lever clips, and side-to-side layout match old parts; no reused weak springs remain in the rear drum/handbrake system.
do_not_do: Do not fit mismatched springs or incomplete side-to-side hardware.

next_action: Focus on the back splitter/equalizer section that feeds both wheels. Photograph/remove the old section, keep every yoke/clevis/pin/spring, and take it to a Montgomery Road auto-control-cable maker to copy locally.
release_gate: Local assembly pulls both rear wheel levers evenly through a free-moving equalizer, clips into original brackets, adjusts correctly, and releases fully through axle movement.
do_not_do: Do not buy another random catalog cable, use wire-rope clamps as final ends, or replace the splitter with two unequal cables.

next_action: Source the yoke/equalizer/clevis/pin/clip/adjuster pieces locally by sample, likely Bilal Ganj for hard parts and Montgomery Road cable/brake shops for new pins, clips, and springs. Replace all handbrake springs.
release_gate: Every cable-to-wheel connection has new or verified matching pins/clips/springs/adjusters; both wheels apply evenly and release fully without drag.
do_not_do: Do not reuse stretched/weak handbrake springs, substitute wire, or assume the long cable includes wheel-end hardware.

next_action: User reports a simple drum cleanup is done. Still measure inside diameter, scoring, step, cracks, heat checking, and out-of-round per side before final brake assembly.
release_gate: Each cleaned drum passes service-limit inspection or is safely machined/replaced by side-specific decision.
do_not_do: Do not order a generic drum pair before measurement.

item: Brake line clips, P-clips, U-clips, tees, and retainers
next_action: Photograph/count original supports before removal; choose on-hand clips/tees for the same route, and tidy the axle-side routing so new hard lines and parking-brake cable are clipped, sleeved, and clear of chafe points.
release_gate: Lines and cables are retained without metal-on-metal rub, unsupported spans, or binding through suspension travel; axle-side brackets/clip points are cleaned and protected.
do_not_do: Do not move brake lines to suit stocked clips, use cable ties, or fit plumbing tees/compression unions.

next_action: Confirm caps/plugs, catch bottle/tray, brake cleaner, rags, clear bleed hose, nitrile gloves, and sealed DOT 3 before opening lines.
release_gate: Open ports capped immediately; final bleed uses clean fresh DOT 3 and no unknown old fluid.
do_not_do: Do not open the hydraulic system without caps and catch setup ready.

next_action: Send the removed booster for professional service/rebuild using the old unit as the sample; exchange unit only if rebuild is not viable and the sample match is proven.
release_gate: Video gate: old sample identity, side-by-side or before/after match, interface close-ups, vacuum hold for at least 60 seconds, assist movement, contamination check, and final acceptance before payment/collection.
do_not_do: Do not buy a raw untested used booster, single/drum booster, welded shell, wrong pushrod/stud pattern, or unit with vacuum leakdown.

next_action: With drums/hardware off, clean the backing-plate outside face, axle tube bracket area, clip points, and wheel-cylinder/hard-line entry area; inspect for axle seal leaks, cracks, loose brackets, chafe marks, and corroded fasteners before reassembly.
release_gate: Axle-side brake area is clean, dry, leak-free, lightly protected/painted only where appropriate, and all brake line/cable supports are tidy without contaminating friction surfaces.
do_not_do: Do not paint friction surfaces, rubber boots, bleeders, threads, flare seats, drum faces, shoe linings, or mask leaks with paint/undercoat.
